{{Quote|It's okay. We already screened it for contact poisons, electronic devices, and sharp edges.|SecOps Seven, handing a flexiplast flier to Koth Melan|<ref name="Safehouse Besh (story)">{{WEGCite|story=Safehouse Besh (short story)|book=Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook}}</ref>}}
'''SecOps Seven''' was a member of the [[Bothan Spynet/Legends|Bothan Spynet]] and personal bodyguard to [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Spy/Legends|Spymaster]] [[Koth Melan]]. 

One time, he worked alongside two other bodyguards, known as [[SecOps Four]] and [[SecOps Five]] when Melan was returning to [[Safehouse Besh]]. He reported to his rear that he found something on the hatch, and Four was sent to assist. It turned out that it was a [[Flexiplast]] flier from [[Krazy Khzam's Repulsor Lot|local repulsor lot]]. After being scanned for poisons, devices, or other dangerous elements, he reported that the area was clear, and handed it to Melan. Melan commended him and ordered the litter to be cleaned up. Seven led Melan inside, and served him [[Gruvian Tovash]].
